question: Name one feature added in the latest Autodesk Fusion update.
answer: One feature added in the latest Autodesk Fusion update is **Auto Timeline**, which uses AI-assisted feature reconstruction to convert imported geometry into an editable, parametric Fusion design. [[1]]
